messages:
elaine: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem — we identified three root causes for the aggregation skew: missing spans in the trace ETL, a late schema change in the ingestion pipeline, and a silent backfill that reprocessed partial chunks.
raj: thanks. can we list owners and specific due dates? I want to make sure this doesn't slip.
nana: assigning owners now: RDW-7812 for span-loss fixes -> @ana, RDW-7820 for ingestion schema reconciliation -> @leo, RDW-7833 for backfill gating & replay safety -> @mike.
elaine: perfect. proposed timelines: ana -> end of week for hotfix + smoke tests; leo -> 2 weeks for reconciliation + migration plan; mike -> design gated backfill within 3 weeks.
raj: sounds reasonable. ana, can you confirm your hotfix will include metric increment so we can detect regressions?
nana: yes — incrementing metric observability.span_loss.count and adding a debug sampler for affected traces. will push PR tomorrow morning.
leo: for schema reconciliation I'm going to add a compatibility layer in ingestion that tolerates missing optional fields. I'll prototype by EOW sprint checkpoint, but migration plan target 2 weeks.
mike: backfill gating: I'll add atomic replay checkpoints and a manifest so we can resume safely. putting a canary reprocess to run on prod shadow first. target in 3 weeks but will have a small test run next Tue.
elaine: thanks. also want a short-term detection rule so SRE gets an alert if span ingestion falls below threshold. @sre-bot can you add alerting on observability.span_ingest.rate drop >30% for 5m?
sre-bot: created alert: OBS-SPAN-INGEST-DROP #alerts. Trigger condition: rate_drop > 30% over 5m. Escalation: eng-oncall -> observability team.
raj: good. add a dashboard card with a solid baseline and expected variance so product and cs teams don't panic.
nana: will add a card to the obs dashboard with pre/post heatmap. also adding a small eval set to ensure aggregation results match expectations after fix.
leo: question about repeated pattern — we've seen missing spans twice in last 6 months. can we add a recurring check to catch regressions earlier?
mike: +1. propose a weekly job that samples a golden trace set and validates that spans are present and counts match. RDW-7901 to track.
elaine: owner for RDW-7901?
raj: I'll own process + runbook for recurring checks, but assign implementation to platform QA.
nana: PR link for hotfix -> https://git.redwood/rdw/observability/pulls/1423 : includes metric bump and doc.
elaine: nice. let's set two check-ins: quick sync in 48h to verify ana's hotfix deployed and the alert is firing correctly, then weekly asynchronous updates on the tickets.
raj: 48h sync scheduled: Thu 09:30 PT.
leo: timeline noted. I'll post a migration plan draft in RDW-7820 by Tue EOD.
mike: RDW-7833 manifest design in progress, will post draft by next Mon.
nana: hotfix PR merging in ~2h, will monitor and post smoke test logs here.
elaine: action item summary: RDW-7812 (ana) hotfix & metric — due +48h; RDW-7820 (leo) schema reconciliation plan — due 2w; RDW-7833 (mike) gated backfill design — due 3w; RDW-7901 (platform QA / raj) weekly golden-trace check — owning process.
raj: also noting cross-team comms: CS + Analytics to be notified after backfill; product PM loop-in after migration plan finalized.
nana: smoke tests passed on canary, logs: ```
PASS  observability.span_fix.hotfix.smoke  18s
metrics: observability.span_loss.count = 0 (after patch)
```
leo: great. can we add an automated regression alert that triggers when aggregation delta > 2% vs baseline for top 10 customers? helps catch edge cases.
mike: agree — putting that as follow-up task in RDW-7833.
elaine: thanks everyone. I'll own weekly postmortem follow-up tracker and ping this thread each Monday with status table. Closing this thread for ad-hoc chat; please update the respective tickets after any changes. :thumbsup:
raj: closing loop. thanks.
nana: thanks all.
leo: thanks.
mike: thanks!
